items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: Interviewer mentions Chris Smith wrote a song and was paid; Interviewee responds 'Really, I'm surprised he paid him.'

ctx.x: And that's not right, not to be able to perform. It's okay for somebody else to do what you do as long as you do what you do too, right? (LAUGHTER).

And get paid as well for doing what you do. (LAUGHTER). Especially something that you started in the first place. (LAUGHTER). That song that Harold Arlen that made so famous and Chris Smith wrote it and he paid Chris twenty five dollars for it. I'll think of the name in a minute, but anyway, that's an unusual circumstance when he paid anything for it.
Really, I'm surprised he paid him.
